prompt: If I was teaching about the Atlantic Slavs trade, provide 5 topics to discuss about the treatment of the slaves
judge_reasoning: Candidate 1 and 3 both provide five clearly slavery-treatment-focused teaching topics (conditions in transit, abuse, plantation/forced labor, psychological impacts, resistance), with only general, widely accepted details. Candidate 2 contains significant likely factual errors and implausible specifics in its example of resistance events (e.g., “Russian-owned Kamchatka Peninsula” in the context of the Atlantic trade), making it unreliable despite covering relevant themes. Candidate 4 drifts toward medieval/other trade networks and includes clearly dubious specifics (e.g., Charlemagne-related decrees and late-Middle-Ages decline of the Atlantic slave trade), reducing topical accuracy and treatment focus.
